import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { AuthService } from '../../services/auth.service'; import { User } from '../../models/user.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard', templateUrl: './dashboard.component.html', styleUrls: ['./dashboard.component.scss'] }) export class DashboardComponent implements OnInit { user: User | null = null; constructor(private authService: AuthService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.authService.currentUser$.subscribe(user => { this.user = user; }); } isAdmin(): boolean { return this.user?.roles?.some(role => role.name === 'ROLE_ADMIN') || false; } }
